about: Mod authors this project recognises. A listing records that the account and its work were recognised by a maintainer - it is NOT a code review, not a security audit, and not a promise about any future release. An author who is not listed is unvouched, not suspected: most good mods will be by people who never asked to be here. Nothing in this file decides what can be installed. To be listed, open an issue on neostryder/neo-angband from the account that publishes your mods.
